applicationInfo.name: ThreatForest
applicationInfo.description:
### Summary
AI-driven threat modeling platform that generates comprehensive attack trees from project documentation using MITRE ATT&CK framework integration.

### Key objectives
- Automate threat modeling with AI-powered analysis
- Generate detailed attack trees for identified threats
- Map attack paths to MITRE ATT&CK techniques
- Provide actionable security controls and mitigations
- Enable interactive threat visualization

### Use-cases
- Security teams conducting threat modeling assessments
- Developers integrating security into CI/CD pipelines
- Security consultants performing application security reviews
- Organizations creating comprehensive security documentation
- Teams needing MITRE ATT&CK mapped threat intelligence

### Features
- Multi-provider LLM support (AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama)
- Automatic discovery and analysis of threat models and documentation
- Attack tree generation with step-by-step attack paths
- MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping using semantic similarity
- Interactive HTML dashboards with network visualizations
- Kiro IDE integration for real-time threat analysis
- State management with resume capability for long workflows

architecture.description:
### High Level Architecture

#### Application type
Python CLI tool for AI-driven threat modeling and attack tree generation

#### Layers
- CLI interface layer (Rich console, questionnaire)
- Core orchestration layer (Strands agents, state management)
- Tool modules layer (context analysis, extraction, generation, mapping)
- External integrations layer (LLM providers, MITRE ATT&CK)

#### Boundaries
- Internal: Core modules, parsers, utilities
- External: LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.)
- Data: Local file system, MITRE ATT&CK framework

#### Technology components
- Python 3.11+ runtime
- Strands agentic framework for LLM orchestration
- Rich library for CLI interface
- Sentence-transformers for embeddings
- PyTorch for ML operations
- Boto3 for AWS integration

#### Deployment architecture
- Standalone CLI application
- Local execution on user workstation
- Output to project/threatforest/ directories
- Optional Kiro IDE integration

#### APIs
| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|----------|
| AWS Bedrock | HTTP/REST | LLM inference |
| Anthropic API | HTTP/REST | Claude model access |
| OpenAI API | HTTP/REST | GPT model access |
| Gemini API | HTTP/REST | Google model access |
| Ollama | HTTP/REST | Local model access |

#### Security relevant components
- Multi-provider LLM authentication (API keys, AWS credentials)
- File system access for project analysis
- External API communication with threat intelligence
- State management with checkpoint files

### Low Level Architecture
- CLI entry point (threatforest.py, cli.py)
- Strands orchestrator (strands_agent.py)
- Context analysis tool (file discovery, parsing)
- Information extraction tool (project metadata, threat parsing)
- Attack tree generator (Mermaid diagram generation)
- TTC mapping tool (MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping)
- Summary generator (reports, HTML dashboards)
- Parser chain (JSON, YAML, Markdown, ThreatComposer)
- State manager (workflow checkpoints, resume capability)
- Configuration system (multi-provider model selection)

dataflow.description:
### Human actors
- Security analysts conducting threat modeling assessments
- Developers integrating security into development workflows
- Security consultants performing application security reviews
- DevOps engineers running threat analysis in CI/CD pipelines

### External entities
- AWS Bedrock (Claude/Titan models)
- Anthropic API (Claude models)
- OpenAI API (GPT models)
- Google Gemini API
- Ollama (local LLM server)
- MITRE ATT&CK framework (enterprise-attack-18.0.json)

### Processes
- CLI Interface (Rich console, questionnaire wizard)
- Strands Orchestrator (workflow state management)
- Context Analysis Tool (file discovery, categorization)
- Information Extraction Tool (threat parsing, project analysis)
- Attack Tree Generator (Mermaid diagram generation)
- TTC Mapping Tool (MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping)
- Summary Generator (reports, HTML dashboards)

### Data stores
| Store | Type | High-Value (Y/N) |
|-------|------|------------------|
| Project files | File system | Y |
| Threat model files (.tc.json, .yaml, .md) | File system | Y |
| State checkpoints (~/.threatforest/state/) | File system | N |
| MITRE ATT&CK data (enterprise-attack-18.0.json) | File system | N |
| Generated attack trees (project/threatforest/) | File system | Y |
| Configuration files (~/.threatforest/config.yaml) | File system | Y |
| Embeddings cache | Memory/File system | N |

### Trust boundaries
| Zone | Elements | Trust Level |
|------|----------|-------------|
| Local System | CLI, file system, state management | High |
| External LLM APIs | AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini | Medium |
| Local LLM | Ollama server | Medium |
| Output Generation | HTML dashboards, reports | High |

### Data flows (MOST IMPORTANT - will be used for diagram)
| Flow ID | Description | Source | Target | Trust Boundaries Crossed | Assets |
|---------|-------------|--------|--------|-------------------------|--------|
| DF-01 | User initiates analysis | Security Analyst | CLI Interface | None | Commands, project path |
| DF-02 | Project file discovery | CLI Interface | Context Analysis Tool | None | File paths, metadata |
| DF-03 | File content extraction | Context Analysis Tool | Information Extraction Tool | None | Project files, threat models |
| DF-04 | LLM API requests | Information Extraction Tool | External LLM APIs | Local->External | Project context, prompts |
| DF-05 | LLM responses | External LLM APIs | Information Extraction Tool | External->Local | Generated content, analysis |
| DF-06 | Threat statement processing | Information Extraction Tool | Attack Tree Generator | None | Parsed threats, project info |
| DF-07 | Attack tree generation | Attack Tree Generator | External LLM APIs | Local->External | Threat data, generation prompts |
| DF-08 | Generated attack trees | External LLM APIs | Attack Tree Generator | External->Local | Mermaid diagrams, attack paths |
| DF-09 | TTC mapping requests | TTC Mapping Tool | External LLM APIs | Local->External | Attack tree content |
| DF-10 | MITRE technique mappings | External LLM APIs | TTC Mapping Tool | External->Local | Technique IDs, mappings |
| DF-11 | MITRE data lookup | TTC Mapping Tool | MITRE ATT&CK Data | None | Technique queries |
| DF-12 | Technique details | MITRE ATT&CK Data | TTC Mapping Tool | None | Technique metadata |
| DF-13 | Report generation | Summary Generator | Output Files | None | Analysis results, dashboards |
| DF-14 | State persistence | Strands Orchestrator | State Storage | None | Workflow checkpoints |
| DF-15 | Configuration access | All Tools | Config Files | None | API keys, model settings |

metadata.value: Replace plaintext API key storage with secure alternatives like AWS Parameter Store, Azure Key Vault, or encrypted configuration files with proper key derivation functions. Environment variables provide a minimal improvement over plaintext files.

mitigations.content: Implement secure credential storage using environment variables or encrypted key management systems instead of plaintext YAML configuration files

metadata.value: Configure HTTP clients to require TLS 1.3 minimum, validate certificates, and implement certificate pinning for known LLM provider endpoints. This prevents network traffic interception and MITM attacks on API communications.

mitigations.content: Enforce TLS 1.3 for all LLM API communications and implement certificate pinning to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks

metadata.value: Add strict schema validation, size limits, and sanitization for all input parsers. Use safe parsing libraries that prevent deserialization attacks. Implement allowlisting for permitted file structures and content types.

mitigations.content: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization for all parser modules including JSON, YAML, Markdown, and ThreatComposer formats

metadata.value: Implement automated API key rotation on a regular schedule. Monitor for unusual usage patterns, geographic anomalies, and unexpected API call volumes that could indicate compromised credentials.

mitigations.content: Deploy API key rotation mechanisms and implement monitoring for unusual API usage patterns across all LLM providers

metadata.value: Generate cryptographic hashes or digital signatures for all output files. Store signatures separately and verify integrity before file access. This detects tampering of attack trees and reports.

mitigations.content: Implement file integrity monitoring with digital signatures for generated attack trees and security reports

metadata.value: Encrypt sensitive output files at rest and implement file-level access controls. Use role-based permissions to restrict access to threat intelligence based on user roles and need-to-know principles.

mitigations.content: Implement access controls and encryption for generated threat intelligence outputs with role-based permissions

metadata.value: Use DNS over HTTPS to prevent DNS spoofing and implement endpoint certificate verification with known good certificate fingerprints for all LLM provider APIs.

mitigations.content: Implement DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and endpoint verification to prevent LLM API endpoint spoofing attacks

metadata.value: Execute file parsing operations in a sandboxed environment with restricted file system access, network isolation, and limited system privileges to contain potential code injection attacks.

mitigations.content: Add sandboxed execution environment for parsing untrusted threat model files with restricted system access

metadata.value: Verify the integrity of enterprise-attack-18.0.json using cryptographic checksums from MITRE's official distribution. Implement signature verification if available from MITRE.

mitigations.content: Implement cryptographic integrity verification for MITRE ATT&CK data files using checksums and digital signatures

metadata.value: Implement content analysis to detect suspicious patterns in LLM responses such as script injection attempts, unusual formatting, or content that doesn't match expected threat modeling outputs.

mitigations.content: Deploy LLM response validation and content filtering to detect and block potentially malicious generated content

metadata.value: Generate HTML dashboards with strict CSP headers that prevent inline script execution. Sanitize all dynamic content and use trusted CDN sources for JavaScript libraries like vis-network.js.

mitigations.content: Implement Content Security Policy (CSP) headers and JavaScript sanitization for generated HTML dashboards

metadata.value: Encrypt state checkpoint files using AES-256 encryption with user-derived keys. Implement file permissions that restrict access to the application user only.

mitigations.content: Implement secure state file encryption and access controls for workflow checkpoint data

metadata.value: Implement circuit breaker pattern to fail fast when LLM APIs are unavailable. Add configurable retry limits and exponential backoff to prevent API abuse and rate limit exhaustion.

mitigations.content: Deploy circuit breaker pattern and retry limits to prevent DoS attacks against LLM APIs and protect against rate limit exhaustion

metadata.value: Add allowlist-based file type validation and content scanning during file discovery. Implement size limits and scan for known malicious patterns before processing discovered files.

mitigations.content: Implement file type validation and content scanning for project file discovery to prevent processing of malicious files

metadata.value: Implement automated backup of generated attack trees and reports. Integrate with version control systems to maintain file history and enable recovery from tampering or accidental deletion.

mitigations.content: Deploy automated backup and recovery mechanisms for critical output files with version control integration

metadata.value: Calculate and verify cryptographic hashes of LLM responses where possible. Implement response pattern analysis to detect unusual or potentially tampered content.

mitigations.content: Implement response integrity verification using cryptographic hashes to detect tampering of LLM API responses

metadata.value: Implement user-based rate limiting and authentication to prevent single users from exhausting API quotas. Add monitoring and alerting for unusual usage patterns.

mitigations.content: Deploy rate limiting and user authentication mechanisms to prevent API quota exhaustion attacks

metadata.value: Use atomic file operations for state file updates and maintain backup copies. Implement file locking to prevent concurrent access corruption and checksums to detect corruption.

mitigations.content: Implement atomic file operations and backup mechanisms for state checkpoint files to prevent corruption

metadata.value: Implement cryptographic hashes for cached embeddings and verify integrity before use. Regenerate embeddings from trusted sources if tampering is detected.

mitigations.content: Deploy integrity monitoring and validation for embeddings cache with cryptographic verification

metadata.value: Create detailed audit logs for all user actions, file operations, and analysis results. Implement digital signatures or cryptographic proofs to ensure non-repudiation of analysis activities.

mitigations.content: Implement comprehensive audit logging and digital signatures for all threat analysis operations to ensure non-repudiation

metadata.value: Filter and minimize project data sent to external LLM providers. Remove sensitive information like credentials, personal data, and proprietary details before API transmission.

mitigations.content: Implement data minimization and selective content filtering for LLM API requests to reduce sensitive data exposure

metadata.value: Implement real-time file system monitoring to detect unauthorized access to configuration files, state directories, and output folders. Generate alerts for suspicious file access patterns.

mitigations.content: Deploy file system monitoring and alerting for unauthorized access to configuration and output directories

metadata.value: Validate configuration files against strict schemas and implement digital signatures for configuration integrity. Reject invalid or tampered configuration files.

mitigations.content: Implement secure configuration validation and schema enforcement to prevent configuration tampering

metadata.value: Monitor network traffic patterns to LLM APIs for anomalies such as unusual request sizes, frequencies, or destinations that could indicate compromise or abuse.

mitigations.content: Deploy network traffic monitoring and anomaly detection for LLM API communications to identify suspicious patterns
